name: tina4-nodejs-benchmarks
description: Competitor benchmark harness for tina4-nodejs. NOT part of the published package. The competitor libraries (Knex, Drizzle) and their SQLite driver (better-sqlite3) live HERE, in this directory's own node_modules, isolated from @tina4/* and NEVER a framework dependency -- the framework itself runs on the built-in node:sqlite and stays zero-dependency. Node's upward module resolution still finds @tina4/orm in the repo-root node_modules. Run `npm install` in this directory, then `npx tsx benchFrameworks.ts` from the repo root.
